text: A single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) is reverse-biased above its breakdown voltage so that one photo-generated carrier triggers a self-sustaining avalanche; this above-breakdown operating mode is called ___ mode.
explanation: Operating an avalanche diode above breakdown, where a single carrier ignites a runaway avalanche, is Geiger mode; the diode must then be quenched to reset. This is how SPADs achieve single-photon sensitivity.
